concerns.text: Success Criterion SC‑005 (overall pipeline runtime ≤ 6 h on a 2‑core CPU) is listed in the spec but no task validates or measures the total end‑to‑end runtime. A dedicated task (e.g., T014) should record the wall‑clock duration of the full pipeline and assert it stays within the 6‑hour budget.

Constitution principle VII mandates a paired‑t‑test “cost‑performance frontier” analysis, yet the task list contains only Spearman correlation and McNemar’s test. Add a task (e.g., T015) that computes the paired t‑test on success rates versus efficiency penalties and validates the result against the required significance criteria.
